title: Speaking — Lunchtime
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on lunchtime.

questions: Where do you usually spend time with friends?
How do you keep in touch with friends you rarely see?
What kinds of activities do you normally do together?
Do you prefer meeting one friend or a group?
What do you usually eat for lunch on a busy day?
Do you have much control over when you take a lunch break?

part2.topic: Describe a lunch break that unexpectedly brightened your day.
part2.closing: and explain why it improved the rest of your day.

questions: How can workplaces make breaks genuinely restorative?
Why is access to healthy and affordable food uneven across city centres?
How has everyday life connected with lunchtime changed for people of different ages?
